name: Oracle Saga
body:
Blending arcane and divine magic, a saga (“witch” in Latin) communicates with the ancestral spirits, granting knowledge and healing to her tribe and allies.

Patron Spells: A saga chooses a witch’s patron at 1st level. She replaces her mystery spells list with her patron spells.

Revelations: A saga must take the following revelations at the indicated levels.

Patron Pact (Su)

You gain a witch’s familiar. This functions as the witch class feature, treating your oracle level as your witch level. You also count as a witch for the purpose of joining a coven. At 5th and 9th level, you gain a witch hex as if you were a witch of your oracle level. You must take this revelation at 1st level.

Speak with Spirits (Su)

Once per day, you can evoke ancestral spirits to answer your questions. The spirits quickly pass before your eyes, communicating with each other to find the one that can answer. This functions as legend lore and has the same casting time, but you can ask for information about non–legendary people and events as well. You must take this revelation at 7th level.

Recommended Mysteries: ancestor, bones, dark tapestry, lore, lunar, nature, occult, time.
